objective: Make the dependency updater resolve the vendored ripgrep and fd releases without the GitHub REST API, then run it for 0.3.2.
scope: Worktree /home/user/holyagent-0.3.2-deps, branch release/0.3.2/chore/update-deps (head de10b1f8, clean). `bunx --no-install mise run deps:update` failed with `https://api.github.com/repos/sharkdp/fd/releases/tags/v10.5.2 answered 403` (log: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-holyagent/43946df6-456d-58c6-bea3-7e958fcb9495/scratchpad/deps-update.log): in this environment the GitHub REST API is refused for repositories outside the session's scope, while anonymous git (`git ls-remote --tags https://github.com/<repo>`, already used for the Actions pins in scripts/update-dependencies.ts:~220) and release asset downloads (`https://github.com/<repo>/releases/download/<tag>/<asset>`, answers 302) work. The same restriction applies to many CI and sandboxed machines, so the updater should not depend on the REST API for vendored binaries.

Change scripts/update-dependencies.ts (and scripts/dependency-pins.ts if needed) so the vendored-binary step finds the newest stable tag with git ls-remote (reuse the existing tag parsing and the prerelease filter) and builds each asset URL from the tag and the asset names the current pins already use, downloading the assets to recompute the checksums as today. If the REST API path carries information the download path cannot (for example the asset list), keep it only as a fallback when it answers, and say so. Update scripts/update-dependencies.test.ts (it stubs https://api.github.com/repos/sharkdp/fd/releases/tags/...) to the new route with fixtures; no live network in tests.

Then run `bunx --no-install mise run deps:update` for real (this needs the network; it is the requested update), then `bunx --no-install mise run build`, `bunx --no-install mise run verify` and `bunx --no-install mise run deps:check`. Expected moves from the earlier dry plan: jdx/mise-action v5.2.6 -> v5.2.7, fd 10.5.1 -> 10.5.2, @tintinweb/pi-subagents 0.23.1 -> 0.23.2, billion-context 0.1.212 -> 0.1.213, @amaster.ai/pi-computer-use 0.1.36 -> 0.1.37, @opencode/browse 0.0.15 -> 0.0.16, plus whatever else the updater finds (browser-use on PyPI, package.json ranges, bun.lock). Never hand-edit a pin, checksum or bun.lock. If verify fails because of a new version, report the failing tests and the move that caused them, and fix only what a version move broke when the fix is small and clearly local; otherwise stop and report.
List every version that moved (from -> to).
